column4: Large means and medians retain their represented values instead of overflowing display rounding.
Concurrent statistics initialization no longer deadlocks while registering built-in facts.
Incomplete question rates now round outward so their displayed bounds remain conservative.
Text filters offer known empty values separately from missing recordings.
Added reproduced startup, large-number, rate-rounding and empty-filter cases with native Android answer and picker checks.
Save regressions restore their temporary file services after execution and use names describing their verified behavior.
Verified 100,000 TEST79 dungeon seeds without changing loot probabilities; generated armor and player encounters remain distinct.
Recorded the preceding delivered APK and this batch's evidence and build checks.
I fixed several misleading statistics displays and an initialization deadlock. Empty recorded values are now selectable without treating missing data as empty.
